candidates.title: Shotwick Castle, plan from Mackenzie, The Castles of England (1897)
candidates.why: 306a audit 2026-10-12: the drawn moated ring spans ~188 m (the whole plate at the fitted 0.2289 m/px), but the scheduled earthworks are at most ~90 m across (40 m x 20 m hexagonal motte, 25 m-wide surrounding ditch, 38 m bailey - NHLE 1016616): the fit is ~2x too big. The 4 turret anchors carry 2-19 m residuals: that is the scale mismatch, not placement error.
